results.title: Family received only 'half justice', says Ankit Balyan's father after UP Police encounter
results.description: Satbir Singh said that while the family is satisfied with the police action, they believe that justice will be fully served only when the remaining suspects are eliminated.

results.title: Trump posts AI video of Iran's Kharg oil hub in ‘smithereens’ as sides trade first attacks since July
results.description: U.S. President Donald Trump posted an AI-generated video clip that he said was Iran’s oil hub Kharg Island being blown to smithereens, hours after the two countries traded attacks for the first time since July.

results.title: Who is Firdaus Daud, the lawyer taking over Faishal Ibrahim’s grassroots responsibilities in Kembangan?
results.description: Ahmad Firdaus Daud, a lawyer and PAP reserve candidate in the 2025 General Election, will be taking over former Acting Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs Faishal Ibrahim’s grassroots responsibilities in Kembangan.
